title: Simulations Reveal Unique Roles for the FXR Hinge in the FXR-RXR Nuclear Receptor Heterodimer.
authors: Yu, Tracy; Biswas, Arumay; Dube, Namita; Okafor, C Denise
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学与增强采样模拟研究FXR-RXR核受体异二聚体与DNA复合物的动态结构，揭示铰链区在DNA结合和域间别构中的关键作用，高度契合TF-DNA互作机制建模课题。
abstract: Nuclear receptors are multidomain transcription factors whose full-length quaternary architecture is poorly described and understood. Most nuclear receptors bind DNA as heterodimers or homodimers, which could encompass a variety of arrangements of the individual domains. Only a handful of experimental structures currently exist describing these architectures. Given that domain interactions and protein-DNA interactions within transcriptional complexes are tightly linked to function, understanding the arrangement of nuclear receptor domains on DNA is of utmost importance. Here, we employ modeling and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to describe the structure of the full-length farnesoid X receptor (FXR) and retinoid X receptor alpha (RXR) heterodimer bound to DNA. Combining over 100 mus of atomistic MD simulations with enhanced sampling simulations, we characterize the dynamic behavior of eight FXR-RXR-DNA complexes, showing that these complexes support a range of quaternary architectures. Our simulations reveal critical roles for the hinge in the DNA-bound dimer in facilitating interdomain allostery, mediating DNA binding and driving the dynamic flexibility of the complex. These roles have been hard to appreciate previously due to experimental limitations in studying the flexible hinge. These studies provide a much-needed framework that will enable the field to obtain a complete understanding of nuclear receptor quaternary architectures.
abstract_zh: 核受体是多结构域转录因子，其全长四级结构尚未得到充分描述和理解。大多数核受体以异二聚体或同二聚体形式结合DNA，这可能包含各结构域的多种排列方式。目前仅有少数实验结构描述了这些构型。鉴于转录复合物中的结构域相互作用和蛋白质-DNA相互作用与功能紧密相关，理解核受体结构域在DNA上的排列至关重要。在此，我们采用建模和分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟来描述全长法尼醇X受体（farnesoid X receptor, FXR）与维甲酸X受体α（retinoid X receptor alpha, RXR）异二聚体结合DNA的结构。结合超过100微秒的全原子MD模拟与增强采样模拟，我们表征了八个FXR-RXR-DNA复合物的动态行为，表明这些复合物支持一系列四级构型。我们的模拟揭示了铰链区在DNA结合二聚体中的关键作用，包括促进结构域间变构、介导DNA结合以及驱动复合物的动态柔性。由于研究柔性铰链区的实验限制，这些作用此前难以被充分认识。这些研究提供了一个亟需的框架，将使该领域能够全面理解核受体的四级构型。
